products.name: Tiny Acres
products.description: One shared puzzle a day: match the edges, and your acre grows into one landscape. No lives, no timers.

share_image.alt: Tiny Acres, a calm daily puzzle: no lives, no timers, no way to lose. A finished acre of natural hex tiles, its woods, lakes, fields, villages and snowy peaks running on into one another.

update.name: Worlds
update.summary: piece together landscapes, one acre at a time
update.text: Piece together three landscapes, Meadow Valley, Lakeside and Snowy Mountains, one acre at a time. Each acre is cut into hexagon pieces with one right place: hold a piece over a gap and gold sides show where it fits. A free hint each level, and every area is free. Worlds is in the apps; the web page stays the daily puzzle.

channels.label: Play in your browser
channels.cta: Play today's acre in your browser

screenshots.alt: One cozy puzzle a day: today's acre part-way, a forest tile with a lake edge tried in a cell beside woods, lakes, fields, villages and mountains, the cells it could go in glowing. Score 36, target 68.
Match the edges, grow a landscape: today's acre finished, its gaps grown in, so woods, lakes, fields, villages and mountains run on into one another. Score 79, target 68.
A path through three landscapes: Worlds' path through Meadow Valley, 3 of 7 acres done and Level 4 next.
Gold sides show where it fits: a Worlds level in Meadow Valley, a river piece held over its gap with gold sides, a dotted piece not yet in place, 9 of 19 in place.
Seven acres, one picture: Meadow Valley so far, three acres finished, the next one glowing gold and empty, the rest hidden in fog.
Keep every finished area: the Worlds gallery, Snowy Mountains and Lakeside each shown whole with a share button.

features: Match forests with forests and lakes with lakes, and close regions for bonus points.
Natural 3D tiles: wheat rows, woods, cobbled villages and lakes with shallows, and a finished acre grows its gaps into one landscape.
Beat the day's target, keep your streak, and share your little map. Friends play the same tiles in their browser.
Cozy acoustic music, seasons and festivals, and a dark mode.

money.title: Fair and simple
money.text: Free to play, with a few ads that never interrupt the daily acre. Tiny Acres Plus is one optional, one-time purchase that removes them. No subscription, no in-game currency, no loot boxes.

products.name: Big Deal
products.pitch: One large-print solitaire deal a day.
products.description: The same deal for everyone, checked by computer so it can always be finished. No timer, and unlimited undo.

screenshots.alt: Large print. One deal a day: a solitaire table with big, clear cards, Deal #16, Gentle Monday, par 165.
Tap to move. No clock: a hint suggests moving the three of spades to column 3.
Finish under par for gold: won in 150 moves, par 165, with a gold medal and a 16-day streak.
Every deal checked by computer: the home screen with today's deal and the last seven days.
Readable your way: settings for card size, a four-colour deck, high-contrast cards and a left-handed layout.

features: Large print, in the card size you like: Normal, Large or Extra large.
A four-colour deck, high-contrast cards and a left-handed layout, if you want them.
Tap a card to move it. No clock, and undo as often as you like.
Finish under par for a gold medal, and keep your streak going.
Play past deals from the archive.

money.title: Fair and simple
money.text: Free to play, with a few ads that never appear inside a deal. The first hint in each deal is free. Remove all ads is one optional, one-time purchase. No subscription, no in-game currency, no loot boxes.

products.name: TravelCharika
products.pitch: When to go, and where to book.
products.description: A travel website and Android app. Each place's twelve months are scored from ten years of measured weather and the holidays that crowd it, so you can see the best time to go.

channels.label: Android app in testing
channels.cta: Android app on Google Play (in testing)

features: Every place's twelve months, scored from ten years of measured weather and the public holidays that crowd it.
Which months are good for hiking, the sea, skiing and the northern lights.
The big festivals, carnivals and markets, month by month.
Where to book, once you know when to go.

money.title: How it's paid for
money.text: TravelCharika is free to use. Some of the booking sites it lists pay it a commission; that never decides which sites are listed or in what order.
